import re

def format_total_price(s):
    # Extract all names and prices from the string
    names = re.findall(r'[a-z]+', s)
    prices = re.findall(r'\d+\.\d{2}', s)
    
    # Convert prices to float and sum them up
    total_price = sum(float(price) for price in prices)
    
    # Format the total price back to the required format
    total_price_str = f"{total_price:.2f}"
    total_price_str = total_price_str.replace('.', '')
    
    # Insert dots for every three digits from the right
    while len(total_price_str) > 3:
        total_price_str = total_price_str[:-3] + '.' + total_price_str[-3:]
    
    return total_price_str
